findings.claim: On the Romero Canyon Trail, hikers often get into trouble within the first few miles after the deceptively flat Catalina State Park bajadas give way to a steeper rocky climb toward Pusch Ridge.
findings.label: Coffee or Die, 2022

findings.claim: The Finger Rock Trail is a documented place where hikers have lost their way in the Santa Catalina Mountains.
findings.label: Arizona Daily Star report

findings.claim: In the upper Sabino Creek watershed on the Arizona Trail near a saddle overlooking the west fork of Sabino Creek, hikers can mistakenly continue up a wrong trail and end up down in a drainage below.
findings.label: The Beckoning trip report

findings.claim: Marshall Gulch Trail #3 descends a cool, shady canyon from the Mount Lemmon area, making Marshall Gulch a specific downhill line a disoriented hiker could follow.
